body:
No material objection. Strongest minimal policy: dynamic/live card visibility is lease-backed. On loss of authenticated PublicCardStream heartbeat, hide immediately at the application state transition; do not add a grace interval because urgent privacy/rights retract cannot reach the Stage. To avoid flicker from a transient packet, connection loss itself can be declared only after a short transport liveness deadline (e.g. missed heartbeat/close, value chosen by E2), but once DISCONNECTED is entered visibility is zero immediately. Curated/preapproved cards may persist only when artifact metadata explicitly says `offlineDisplayAllowed=true` and has a local `expiresAt`; slide binding mismatch still hides instantly. Blank/slide content remains.
Accept state additions: `PublicCardEvent = upsert | tombstone`, card states include PUBLISHED/RETRACTED/EXPIRED, independent ordered revision, tombstone watermark/retention sufficient to prevent resurrection on stale snapshots. Public IDs should be non-correlatable projection IDs; event carries public deck manifest hash, public slide key/seq binding, card schema/version, expiry.
Accept command precedence exactly: validate auth/session/current lease+epoch first; old epoch -> STALE_CONTROLLER even if commandId seen. Then dedupe `(session,actor,epoch,commandId)` with request hash; identical returns original acceptance receipt, different hash -> IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Separate `command.accepted` from `stage.applied`; reject relative commands unless one ready bound Stage exists.
Accept capability separation: PlaybackControlLease, PublicationAuthority (may be multiple actors but transition CAS-serialized), CaptureGrant bound to capture device/session, DisplayBinding epoch. Controller takeover must not stop capture unless policy explicitly couples those capabilities.
Accept retention repair: append-only/tamper-evident within a bounded retention window, not immutable forever. Reports derive from purpose-limited structured metrics/events; deletion cascade uses subject/session keys and produces a receipt outside deleted payload, with only minimal non-personal aggregate/accounting evidence retained under policy.
summary: State refinements accepted with immediate fail-closed policy
